long: Grand Theft Auto 2 is a top-down open-world action game set in a retro-futuristic city divided among rival criminal gangs, where the player takes on missions, builds reputation with each gang and causes mayhem for cash. It expanded on the original with a gang-respect system and more chaotic sandbox play. Released as freeware by Rockstar, this NT-kernel-patched portable build runs through Proton.
